text.en: Reviews present contrasting opinions regarding the salon personnel following recent management changes. Many clients praise individual groomers for being kind, patient, and welcoming with anxious dogs. However, several critical reviewers report dismissive customer service, staff turnover, and inflexible communication regarding bookings.

Most pet parents appreciate how gently the groomers interact with their pets during appointments. Reviewers frequently describe staff taking extra time with nervous spaniels and cockapoos, avoiding rushed handling around sensitive facial areas. Aside from one report of grooming distress, the general consensus reflects affectionate pet care.

Feedback concerning grooming finishes shows a mixture of satisfaction and concern. Several reviewers share enthusiasm over clean, tidy styling and beautiful coat trims for their dogs. Conversely, a severe complaint cited an accidental laceration during a grooming session, leading to divergent client assessments of overall service quality.

q.en: What services does Elite Dog Spa West End offer?

a.en: The salon offers full dog grooming, puppy packages, spa treatments, coat styling, and supervised dog daycare.

q.en: Does the salon accommodate nervous or anxious dogs?

a.en: Yes, multiple reviewers note that groomers are patient and work gently with anxious pets without forcing uncomfortable procedures.

q.en: What payment methods are reported by customers?

a.en: Customer feedback mentions a cash payment preference at the salon, while cancellations may incur direct booking fee charges.
